errors.notes: Server/external validation errors keyed by Field.Root name; merged into field state and cleared per-field once that field's value changes.

onFormSubmit.notes: Receives a plain object of values; preventDefault() is called on the native submit event automatically. Generic over FormValues.

actionsRef.notes: Form.Actions = { validate: (fieldName?: string) => void } — validates all fields, or one by name.

action.type: native form attributes via BaseUIComponentProps<'form', ...> + React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'form'>
action.notes: React server-form actions are supported: <Form action={formAction} errors={state.errors}> with useActionState.

dataAttributes: None documented; FormState is an empty object

renderProp.mechanism: render on Form (props are the full React form props + state)

controlled.note: Form holds no value state; values come from the DOM at submit time.

formIntegration.nameValue: Delegated to the fields inside; each Field.Root name becomes a key in the submitted values and in the errors object.
formIntegration.validation: Native constraint validation first, then Field.validate. Documented modes: onSubmit (default; re-validates invalid fields on change), onBlur, onChange. Async validate + validationDebounceTime supported. Third-party libraries (React Hook Form, TanStack Form) integrate by forwarding name/field/fieldState into Field parts. Hidden inputs are how non-native controls join submission, and the docs advise wrapping them in a relatively positioned container so the native validation bubble points at the right spot.

keyboard.keys: Native: Enter submits the form (docs note validation runs once on Enter inside a Form in 1.8.0 changes).

notableDifferences: React Aria's Form is a thin native form with validation behaviour; Base UI's Form adds consolidated error handling: errors prop keyed by field name, onFormSubmit with a values object, and actionsRef.current.validate([fieldName]).
Submission via onFormSubmit auto-calls preventDefault on the native event, so migrating from React Aria's onSubmit/action needs care — the event object is available in eventDetails.event.
Field-level validationMode overrides the form-level one (opposite precedence direction from React Aria's per-field validationBehaviour being separate).
Server errors are cleared automatically when the corresponding field changes.
